title: Side Line Wingback Bed – Upholstered Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
Fine side lines run along the wings of the Side Line Wingback Bed, giving a winged headboard a sleeker, more designed look. The headboard and wings are deeply padded and the bed is handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Side line detailing along the winged headboard
  • Deeply padded headboard and wings
  • Solid timber slatted base
  • Free fabric swatches

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £285.99; Small Double (4FT) £311.99; Double (4FT6) £324.99; King (5FT) £350.99; Super King (6FT) £402.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a solid wood frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

We deliver free to addresses across Great Britain with our own delivery team, normally in 3-5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days for unused, unassembled items in original packaging (we collect). Faulty items are replaced free or refunded in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What makes the Side Line different from a plain wingback?

The extra line detailing along the wings; the Liberty Wingback is the plain option, from £272.99.

What sizes does it come in?

Single (3FT) to Super King (6FT), from £285.99.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
